purpose: Declare every corpus the project reads, its license basis, whether this project may redistribute it, and where that claim is evidenced. scripts/audit_development_corpus_license.py verifies this file and scripts/build_release_archive.py consults release_paths before shipping.

policy.license_is_not_redistribution_right: A permissive license on code does not grant redistribution rights over data compiled from third-party databases.
policy.blocked_until_evidenced: A corpus marked not_verified must not ship measurement data inside a public release archive.
policy.evidence_required: Every entry must name at least one repository path that a reader can open to check the claim.
policy.release_paths_are_authoritative: release_paths maps frozen artifact paths to the corpus they belong to; an unowned path is an audit failure.

corpora.description: UniKP/DLKcat kcat development corpus used for all trained models and the frozen homology-cold split.
corpora.license_basis: Corpus-level provenance only. Underlying measurements derive primarily from BRENDA as compiled by the UniKP project; no record-level citation or redistribution grant is recorded.
corpora.blocking_reason: Upstream compilation terms are unresolved, so no measurement row from this corpus may ship in a public archive.

derived_artifacts_in_release.note: Row counts, duplicate counts, and the source file hash only. Carries a local absolute source path that must be redacted before a double-blind deposit.
Records why governed Km training is blocked; no Km values or sequences.
Holds cluster id, sequence id, source row, and split assignment only; no sequences and no kcat values.
Derived from the corpus. Weights are not a redistribution of the measurements, but the derivation is declared so reviewers can judge fit.

corpora.description: Frozen temporal and homology-cold absolute-kinetics pool. Below its record and family gates, never scored.
corpora.license_basis: The frozen protocol admits only CC0 or CC BY 4.0 measurement tables with explicit deposit coverage. Per-source coverage is asserted by the acquisition registry.
corpora.scientific_caveat: Pool is below its record and family gates and has never been scored. Its presence in the archive is frozen input evidence, not a released benchmark, and must not be cited as validation.
